audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Quinn five of seven rows while every why underneath described Olaf winning them. The packet and the audited mirror read Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Quinn.
audit.why: whys[0] through whys[5] all state Olaf out-trades, out-sustains or runs you down; the chart said Quinn anyway. On a 47.92% matchup a Quinn-majority chart is indefensible.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 through 5 flipped to Olaf as one atomic group across both layers, row 6 kept as Quinn, and all seven ratings moved so the number agrees with the row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer describes Ragnarok as 'cleanses CC' and never states its actual condition, never gives Undertow's pickup reset, and never mentions that Reckless Swing is true damage — while recommending Plated Steelcaps as though armour answered him.
audit.why: Riot text: Ragnarok makes him 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking' (100/90/80s) — a duration you can end by denying him a target. Undertow is a flat 9s that 'the ability's cooldown is reset' on axe pickup, so the axe on the ground is the real timer. Reckless Swing deals true damage at 325 range on 11/10/9/8/7s. Berserker Rage scales attack speed and lifesteal off missing health, so he heals hardest when he looks killable.
audit.corrected: All four written in with numbers: Ragnarok's condition and cooldown, Undertow's flat 9s plus the pickup reset (deny the pickup), Reckless Swing's true damage and 325 range, and Berserker Rage's missing-health scaling as the reason anti-heal is bought early.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer's early/mid/late is written in the FIRST PERSON — 'my Q blind', 'I blind his autos', 'I don't have my W steroid'. Every other matchup on the site is second person.
audit.why: The user's approved voice is second-person coaching. A page that switches to 'I' reads as someone else's notes.
audit.corrected: early, mid and late rewritten in second person at the same length, with the ability names filled in at the same time.

edits.before: Olaf just runs at you, and that is the whole problem early. His axe (Q) slows you and refunds its own cooldown when he picks it up, so dodging it is everything — sidestep the throw and he loses both the slow and his mana sustain. My Q blind makes his autos miss, which buys a little, but his W lifesteal heals the trade right back and I don't have my W steroid until level 2. Last-hit at range, chip with Q, and never let him pin me against the wall before level 3.
edits.after: Olaf just runs at you, and that is the whole problem early. Undertow slows you and refunds its own 9s cooldown the moment he picks the axe back up, so dodging it is only half the job — sidestep the throw, then stand between him and the axe. Blinding Assault makes his autos miss, which buys a little, but Berserker Rage lifesteals the trade right back and you have no W steroid until level 2. Last-hit at range and never let him pin you on the wall before 3.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are where he takes over. He out-sustains my poke with W, and at 6 his R turns off my entire kit — CC-immune walks through my E slow, and his true damage means my blind on his autos barely slows the run-down. Don't try to duel a Reckless Swing Olaf head-on; bait the R, kite with my W move speed, and only re-engage once it drops and his axe is on the ground behind him. Use my own R to roam and make my gold somewhere he can't follow instead of feeding the lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are where he takes over. He out-sustains your poke with Tough It Out, and at 6 Ragnarok turns your kit off — he is immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking, so your Vault slow means nothing, and Reckless Swing's true damage goes through anything you bought. Don't duel him head-on. Bait Ragnarok, kite with W's move speed, and re-engage only once it lapses and his axe is on the ground behind him. Use your own R to earn gold where he cannot follow.

edits.before: This is the only stage that tilts my way, and only if I've stayed even. A no-R Olaf in open ground is finally killable: I blind his autos with Q, knock him off with E, and kite with W attack and move speed while my range and Harrier resets chip him down. But I'm squishy and he's tanky with lifesteal, so I can't 1v1 him through his R — I need teammates or open space. If he snowballed the early levels, he just outscales my fragile carry pattern and I have to play the map, not the duel.
edits.after: This is the only stage that tilts your way, and only if you stayed even. A no-Ragnarok Olaf in open ground is finally killable: blind his autos with Blinding Assault, knock him off with Vault, and kite with W's attack and move speed while your range and Harrier resets chip him down. You are squishy and he is tanky with lifesteal, so you cannot duel through Ragnarok — you need teammates or open ground. If he snowballed the early levels, play the map, not the duel.

edits.before: Hold your Q blind for his R window — it does nothing vs the true damage but the autos still hit, so save it to disengage instead
edits.after: Hold Blinding Assault for the Ragnarok window — it won't touch Reckless Swing, but blinding his autos still cuts most of his damage

notes: TWO FLAG MISFIRES, both left out of the page per the trust-the-description rule. (1) The kit tags Undertow with grounding: 'shuts off enemy dashes'. Riot's text for Undertow says damage, armour reduction and move speed slow only — no grounding. If it really grounds, it would deny Vault and would be the single most important line in this matchup, so it is worth someone confirming. (2) The kit tags Ragnarok hardCC, and _missing/quinn.json therefore claims Ragnarok can cancel your Behind Enemy Lines channel. Riot's text for Ragnarok is passive resistances plus immunity to disables — it applies no CC at all, so I did NOT write that claim. PACKET NOTE: brief header says 480 games, packet body says 265; either is well over threshold. The suspectNames hit on 'Reckless Swing Olaf' was a real ability name used as an adjective — that sentence is rewritten anyway.
